additional_info.subject: ID0437752-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T6170004787] SIM slot in router not fully inserted CRM:02889000210
additional_info.body:
Hi guys,
The SIM card not being inserted is a normal problem. Just with vibrations it's possible that the SIM gets loose or even more inside.
I face the same issues in the Training Center where you need to insert it just right sometimes. What I mean is:
If you don't insert it fully, then it won't work
If you insert it too much inside, it won't work.
From EoL every charger comes out of the factory 100% working.
If it gets there and it's not working then it is probably due to the transport.
Let me know if this answered your question and I can close the ticket.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
